_README: Free path, LOCAL ONLY (CO-P3-FREE-002): used by harness/run-local-free.js on the owner's machine, never by CI or the orchestrator (they load config/agent-limits.json, mode mock). Planner = Codex CLI on the owner's ChatGPT subscription, worker = Claude Code on the owner's Claude subscription. Mode local-subscription accepts ONLY { subscription: true } entries and 0 USD caps, so no paid route can be configured here. Calls are still counted (max_calls_per_task, loop detector). Worker tools: file tools only (--restricted), path rules bound to the working directory (the disposable clone).
